backend/main.mo: Main Motoko canister containing user profiles, food entry management, access control, and data types for nutrition and weekly feedback.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old food entries to the new format by adding a description field.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML page loading the React app root and main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App router and authentication gate ensuring users complete profile setup before accessing pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity authentication and clearing cached data on sign‑out.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal form for collecting user name and body goal details, validating input, and saving the profile.
frontend/src/components/camera/CapturedP: Shows a captured food photo with options to retake or proceed.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatTranscr: Scrollable chat transcript displaying messages, timestamps, and optional citations.
frontend/src/components/chat/SuggestedPr: Renders selectable suggested questions to help users start a chat.
frontend/src/components/entries/DateRang: Provides forward/back navigation for selecting a date range and displays the formatted range.
frontend/src/components/entries/EmptyEnt: Static empty‑state view encouraging users to add or scan their first meal entry.
frontend/src/components/entries/EntryDet: Dialog showing detailed nutrient info for a food entry, adjusted by portion size and confidence.
frontend/src/components/entries/Estimati: Workflow step for confirming image‑based food estimation with editing, speech input, and entry submission.
frontend/src/components/entries/PortionC: Sliders for adjusting portion size and confidence level, with optional guidance text.
frontend/src/components/entries/SimilarF: Displays a list of similar foods for selection when the image estimation is uncertain.
frontend/src/components/entries/TodayEnt: Renders a list of today's food entries with calories, portion size, confidence, and opens a details dialog on selection.
frontend/src/components/graphs/CaloriesO: Generates a line chart of daily calorie totals over a date range and allows selecting a day.
frontend/src/components/graphs/MacroDist: Displays a pie chart of total protein, carbs, and fat based on all entries.
frontend/src/components/graphs/Nutrition: Calculates a nutrition balance score from macro ratios and confidence, then displays grade, score, and explanation.
frontend/src/components/graphs/WeeklyRat: Shows a 1–10 rating using colored circular markers and a star indicator.
frontend/src/components/graphs/WeeklySum: Displays a weekly nutrition summary with rating, feedback, stats, totals, and suggestions.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the top navigation bar with logo, navigation buttons, user profile, and login.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the global layout including header, footer, theming, and content wrapper.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
Fetches suggested questions from the backend and provides a helper to find or approximate answers.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks to fetch and save the caller's user profile via an actor, with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFoodEntries.ts: Hooks to load food entries for a date range and add new entries using actor calls with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity auth state, including login, stored identity loading, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortionAdjusterGui: Fetches portion adjuster guidance text from the actor using a simple query.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechToText.ts: Browser speech‑to‑text hook handling recognition, errors, transcript accumulation, and start/stop controls.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind setup defining light/dark theme CSS variables and base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entrypoint initializing React, query client, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AddEntryPage.tsx: Form page for manually adding a food entry with nutrition fields, portion adjustment, and submission via mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CameraCapturePage.tsx: Camera capture workflow enabling photo taking, retakes, estimation flow, and handling device support or errors.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page that loads user profile and food entries, computes nutrition totals and weekly summaries, and renders charts and daily entry lists.
frontend/src/pages/HelperChatPage.tsx: Implements a nutrition chat assistant with message history, suggested prompts, and local knowledge‑base responses.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Displays the NutriScan login screen and triggers Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/utils/localFoodDataset.ts: Defines a local nutrition database of foods with categories, keywords, and per‑100g nutrition values.
frontend/src/utils/localNutritionEstimat: Provides simple local food estimation, keyword search, exact lookup, and nutrition‑per‑weight calculations.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, clearing, and managing URL and session‑stored parameters.
frontend/src/utils/weeklyFeedback.ts: Computes weekly nutrition totals, averages, macro percentages, and generates a score, feedback, and suggestions based on logged food entries and body goals.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins for styling the frontend.
project_state.json: Describes the app’s overall state, architecture notes, features, and issues for the NutriScan diet-tracking project.
